title: sync script: session artifacts mishandled on failure — new files orphaned, non-merge edits stranded blocking later merges
description: Reviewer kimi-k3 passes 1.6/3.5 (converged). (a) :159-160 comment claims untracked session files go to the per-worker sync loop, but that loop (:33-55) only scans WORKTREE_BASE/worker*/ — a resolution depending on a session-created new file is silently never committed. (b) 'git merge --abort' (reset --merge) preserves worktree changes outside the merge, so a rejected session's edits to non-merge files strand dirty in main's worktree and block later branches' merges ('local changes would be overwritten'). Fix: fail the run when session-created untracked files exist in the allowed paths; explicitly clean/checkout session-dirtied non-merge paths on the abort paths (:291/:308/:316).
